title: SCOPE-D cloud enumeration / recon containment (read-only sandbox)
description: Bounds the SCOPE-D enumeration and attack-path recon subagents (IAM/KMS/Secrets/STS enum, attack-path mapping) that hold Bash over privileged cloud identity/key/secret surfaces. Deny-by-default: recon runs ONLY in a non-production sandbox, read-only, within a single namespace.
enforcement: deny-by-default: tools/authorize.py DENIES the action unless every required_condition is satisfied by the action context and this policy file resolves. A missing context value for a required condition is treated as unmet (fail-closed).
